name: GIAMIP suggested range
description: The range GIAMIP suggests for experiments whose viscosity structure is labelled 'Within suggested range', which are Exp03 and Exp04. A choice inside this range is made by the group and recorded in the model report.
notes: For the optional experiments the protocol encourages one-dimensional models to explore values well outside this range where a region calls for it, naming West Antarctica and Alaska with upper mantle viscosities of 1e18 to 1e19 Pa s.
